capabilities: Render Gantt timelines from notes in a Base
Zoom by day, week, or month and set task-column width
Show dependencies, milestones, status colors, and a today marker
Export the chart as PNG or paginated PDF
Edit task dates with a review dialog and one-step undo
extras: Desktop-only beta (0.7.1); mobile installation is disabled until device testing is done. Date editing is off by default and labeled experimental. Undo only covers the latest plugin date edit in the current session and clears on reload. No network requests, telemetry, or account required.
problem: Bases shows task dates as table values, so there is no way to see how tasks, milestones, and dependencies line up over time.
summary: Bases view that draws project timelines as Gantt charts with zoom, dependencies, milestones, a today marker, and PNG or PDF export.
